comment: Against the real assembled app once J1-Manga's seeded chapter has opened (isolated session, never the daily pipe). Target is the production reader root, objectName 'comicReaderShell' (qml/MangaReader.qml wraps ComicReaderShell with this name — the same surface J1-Manga-Seam adds readerReady/readerSourceId/readerPageCount/readerPageIndex to). '$rootWindow' is the synthetic whole-window viewport LayoutSnapshot builds from dump-ui's own rootWindow field. 'root' is scoped to the reader itself (found live 2026-08-14: with the Downloads page's tree still mounted underneath plus every pre-warmed world, an unscoped whole-window dump-ui walk did not reach comicReaderShell within the runner's 50-page cap — scoping root to the known-visible reader avoids walking the rest of the app for a checkpoint that only asserts the reader's own geometry).
